name: Heuristic Partitioning for Texture-Based Volume Rendering
definition: A method that partitions Berger-Collella AMR data into homogeneous resolution regions for texture-based hardware-accelerated volume rendering using a heuristic to minimize block count.
summary: Heuristic Partitioning for Texture-Based Volume Rendering partitions AMR data into homogeneous blocks using a placement heuristic to minimize block count, optimizing single-machine hardware-accelerated rendering.
